review_response_tasks.rationale: 主语自行做修理，反身复数themselves。
owner’s explanation为解释这一派生名词。
除非有懂机构的人在场才开盒，unless表示例外条件。
was closed被动/状态分词，抽屉用完关闭。 closing还可作抽屉自身正在关闭的读法，是否符合此处叙事尚未核实，撤销直接排除，未列形式待复核。
promise后普通不定式与进行式指下周返回该店，均合语境，源不加一词上限。
looked后形容词beautiful描述表带外观。

student_passage:
My grandparents do many small repairs (1) ____, but an old watch in the kitchen had defeated them. They took it to a little shop and listened to the owner's (2) ____ of what had gone wrong. The watch needed a new strap as well as a new battery.

The replacement strap was much (3) ____ than the old metal one. A worker (4) ____ the broken fastening and checked that it held securely. Before giving the watch back, the owner explained a simple rule: we should not open the case (5) ____ somebody who understood the mechanism was there to help.

My grandfather asked many questions, and the owner answered (6) ____. He showed us a drawer of tiny tools. Each drawer was (7) ____ after use so that nothing could fall out while the bench was being moved. I had never seen such small screwdrivers before.

It was my (8) ____ visit to the shop, but the first two had been very brief. This time, we stayed until all the work was done that afternoon. Before we left, I promised (9) ____ to the same shop the next week with my brother, who wanted to see the tools too.

The watch was not especially expensive, but its new strap looked (10) ____. Grandmother said the best part was hearing it tick again. She put it on her wrist as we walked out, and Grandfather checked the time on it all the way home.
filled_passage:
My grandparents do many small repairs (1) themselves, but an old watch in the kitchen had defeated them. They took it to a little shop and listened to the owner's (2) explanation of what had gone wrong. The watch needed a new strap as well as a new battery.

The replacement strap was much (3) lighter than the old metal one. A worker (4) repaired the broken fastening and checked that it held securely. Before giving the watch back, the owner explained a simple rule: we should not open the case (5) unless somebody who understood the mechanism was there to help.

My grandfather asked many questions, and the owner answered (6) patiently. He showed us a drawer of tiny tools. Each drawer was (7) closed after use so that nothing could fall out while the bench was being moved. I had never seen such small screwdrivers before.

It was my (8) third visit to the shop, but the first two had been very brief. This time, we stayed until all the work was done that afternoon. Before we left, I promised (9) to return to the same shop the next week with my brother, who wanted to see the tools too.

The watch was not especially expensive, but its new strap looked (10) beautiful. Grandmother said the best part was hearing it tick again. She put it on her wrist as we walked out, and Grandfather checked the time on it all the way home.
